Quick Fix

Code: QKFX

In Etherlords and Etherlords II

Enchanted creature is brought from graveyard to play. Its power and toughness are reduced by 1 (but toughness cannot become less than 1). If this enchantment is removed, the creature returns to graveyard, if enchanted creature is destroyed then return this enchantment to its owner's hand
